title: What It Actually Looks Like to Play to Win and Still Lose Like a Man of God
caption:
Some Christian guys play soft and call it humility. Some play like the scoreboard decides who they are.

Neither one is the man God is building.

Compete all the way. Keep your mouth clean. Hold yourself together when the ref blows the call. Lose without the silent car ride home. Win without rubbing it in.

"Every athlete exercises self-control in all things." 1 Corinthians 9:25

The guys on the other team are watching how you lose more than how you win.

Send this to the brother you play with every week.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #sports #selfcontrol
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
